name: Polymorph
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

You transform a creature within medium range into a non-humanoid creature. Roll Lore and subtract 10; the result determines the maximum Challenge score of the creature form you may choose. If the target is unwilling, also roll Lore vs Spirit. On a loss, the spell has no effect.

While transformed, the transformed creature's stats and abilities are fully replaced by the chosen creature form, including its mental faculties, though the transformed creature retains its personality. It cannot speak unless the creature form can. All worn or carried equipment is melded into the new form. If the transformed creature loses consciousness or when the spell ends, it immediately reverts.

Describe the transformation.
successes:
✨: You may sustain the spell for up to an additional hour.

🌞: The spell lasts for up to one day and does not require concentration.

💀: The instincts of the chosen form overwhelm the target’s personality. It becomes hostile to you and your allies for 1d4 minutes. If it was already hostile, it immediately takes an extra turn. Check a Condition.
